population.definition: the first 100 distinct (game, selection) EV reads frozen after frozen_at under exactly these versions, with a fresh executable quote and a calibrated probability — every decision status included, so PASS is graded as a counterfactual

metrics.what: Brier, log loss, calibration slope and CITL of the calibrated cover probability vs the settled cover (pushes excluded)
CLV and realized ROI by stated calibrated-EV bucket, with n and intervals
line CLV and price CLV at the recorded quote
reads blocked as STALE QUOTE or PRICE UNAVAILABLE
Pr(EV>0) and the 10th-percentile EV against the realized outcome frequency
BET EARLY later deterioration, WAIT target reached / best later price / close
each recorded alternate graded at its own price

rule: Nothing is retuned on these 100 reads while they are called a holdout. A change to a frozen file needs a version bump, or a PATCH row in football/cfb_ev/versions.jsonl naming the new hash; either way, no frozen read is ever rewritten.
